name: Rotator Cuff Repair Rehabilitation
summary: A torn rotator cuff tendon is reattached to the humerus with anchors and sutures. Tendon-to-bone healing is slow, and re-tear is a known complication, more common in large tears, older patients and poor tissue quality.

looksLike: Tear size, tendons repaired, tissue quality, other procedures (biceps tenodesis, acromioplasty), surgeon's protocol and sling time (commonly around 4 to 6 weeks).
redFlags: Sudden pain and loss of active movement after an incident
Increasing stiffness in all directions, severe night pain
Hand swelling, colour change, burning pain
firstSteps: 1: Protection: About 0 to 6 weeks; Sling; elbow, wrist, hand, neck exercises; pendulum; passive or assisted range within limits; Active lifting, resisted exercise, lifting objects
2: Active range: About 6 to 12 weeks; Active-assisted to active elevation, rotation; scapular control; Heavy loading

measures: Range, strength (dynamometer), pain, Oxford Shoulder Score or SPADI, function.

blocks.text: A torn rotator cuff tendon is reattached to the humerus with anchors and sutures. Tendon-to-bone healing is slow, and re-tear is a known complication, more common in large tears, older patients and poor tissue quality [Ref – to verify]. Rehabilitation balances protecting the repair against preventing stiffness. For injury assessment see Vol 5 Ch 1.
Tear size, tendons repaired, tissue quality, other procedures (biceps tenodesis, acromioplasty), surgeon's protocol and sling time (commonly around 4 to 6 weeks) [Ref – to verify].

sections.title: G. RED FLAGS AND URGENT CONDITIONS

rows: Sudden pain and loss of active movement after an incident
Increasing stiffness in all directions, severe night pain
Hand swelling, colour change, burning pain

sections.title: H. Phases (example; always follow the surgeon)

rows: Sling; elbow, wrist, hand, neck exercises; pendulum; passive or assisted range within limits
Active lifting, resisted exercise, lifting objects
Active-assisted to active elevation, rotation; scapular control
Return to heavy or contact activity before cleared

blocks.text: Early versus delayed motion: both approaches show similar long-term outcomes in many trials; early motion may improve early range, with some concern about healing in large tears [Ref – to verify].

Pendulum; supine passive elevation using the other arm; table slides; wand external rotation (within limits); isometrics (when allowed); band external and internal rotation; side-lying external rotation; scapular retraction; progressive elevation with weights; functional and sport-specific training.
Range, strength (dynamometer), pain, Oxford Shoulder Score or SPADI, function.

items: **Why is tendon-to-bone healing slow?** Tendon attaches to bone through a complex zone with limited blood supply.
**What is safe in phase 1?** Elbow, wrist, hand exercises, pendulum and passive range within limits.
**What suggests a re-tear?** Sudden pain and loss of active elevation after an incident.
**Why move the elbow and hand early?** To prevent stiffness and swelling.
**When does strengthening usually start?** Often around 12 weeks, per the surgeon.

sections.title: Now You Should Be Able To

items: Follow phase-based rotator cuff repair rehabilitation.

sections.A: Rotator cuff repair mein phata tendon anchors aur tankon se haddi par wapas joda jata hai. Tendon aur haddi ka jurna aahista hota hai, is liye shuru mein hifazat zaroori hai.
sections.B: Tear ka size, kaun se tendons, tissue ki halat aur saath ki surgeries dekhein; yeh rehab ki raftaar badalte hain.
sections.G: Bukhar, zakhm ki laali ya paani (infection), ya achanak dard aur active movement khatam hona (repair phatna): surgeon ko batayein.
sections.H: Phase 1 hifazat (0-6 hafte), phase 2 active range (6-12 hafte), phase 3 taaqat, phase 4 kaam aur khel. Hamesha surgeon ki hidayat.
sections.J: Pendulum, doosre haath se passive elevation, table slides aur hadd ke andar wand external rotation, phir active aur taaqat.
sections.M: Range, taaqat, dard, Oxford Shoulder Score ya SPADI aur kaam dobara dekhein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Tendon aur haddi ka jurna is liye aahista hai kyunki wahan khoon ka supply kam hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
